metadata.explanation: Drop a failure notification whose delivery exhausted its retries; the Release keeps the failure.
Register exact Project membership before any external build effect.
Wait for an admitted build, source retry or Project cleanup command.
Poll the asynchronous build until it ends or its wait limit passes, without locks.
Stop the provider build of an admitted cancellation and wait until it settles, without locks.
Reconcile and clean every artifact owned by this commit in bounded rounds without locks before completion.
Commit provider observations and the latest successful build pointer; tell the Session of a failed build or a rejected automatic deployment.
Commit the prepared source as DRAFT, or its failure with its owner for an explicit retry and tell the Session of the failure, before exposing configuration.
Complete only after Project-owned cleanup is confirmed.
Admit optional deployment of this exact build using the Live revision fence.
Freeze the accepted draft revision before starting a build; a draft that lacks what the commit declares refuses the build with its gaps.
Reconcile the exact provider build before admitting another effect.
Tell the Project's Session, best effort, of the failure the previous Step committed, then wait for the next command.
Prepare the exact main commit manifest and strict FDG before configuration, polling the provider without locks.
Validate the built manifest and strict Flow Definitions, then publish them as immutable artifacts.
Retain failed or uncertain work for explicit recovery and tell the Session of it.
Turn the cause of failed admission or source preparation into the failure to commit, which the platform owns.
Retain cleanup responsibility until Project retries it.
Resume the exact admitted build phase without changing its identity.
Start the immutable configuration and source build once.
